title: Cell staining for sorting of hematopoietic stem cells \(HSC) and myeloid progenitors and isolating RNA from sorted cells
protocol: Harvest bone marrow (BM) cells and spleen cells and resuspend them in 1×PBS/2%FCS in 50 ml conical tubes.
Spin down at 1300 rpm for 5 minutes.
Discard liquid completely.
Add 500 μl of ACK buffer, pipet and wait on ice or RT for 1-5 minutes (until the solution is clear).
Add 40 ml of 1×PBS/2%FCS and mix.
Spin down at 1300 rpm for 5 minutes.
Resuspend BM cells from 1 mouse in 100 μl of 1×PBS/2%FCS in a 5 ml tube.
Resuspend spleen cells from 1 mouse in 350 μl of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Add 3 μl of anti-CD3-Tc Ab, 2 μl of anti-CD4-Tc antibody, 2 μl of anti-CD8a-Tc Ab, 2 μl of anti-CD19-Tc Ab, 3 μl of anti-Ly-6G (Gr-1)-Tc Ab, and 3 μl of anti-CD45R (B220)-Tc Ab to BM cells.
Mix and incubate for 30 minutes on ice in the dark.
Wash the cells twice with 3 ml of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Resuspend BM cells in 100 μl of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Add 70 μl of Dynabeads to resuspended BM cells.
Rotate tube in dark at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Add 1×PBS/2%FCS to a total volume of 4.5 ml and mix.
Place the tube onto Dynal magnetic rack and leave on the rack for 2 minutes at RT.
Transfer the supernatant containing lineage negative cells to a new tube with a Pasteur pipet.
Spin down at 1300 rpm for 5 minutes.
Resuspend BM cells in 100 μl of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Add 5 μl anti-CD34-FITC Ab, 3 μl of anti-FcγRIII/II-PE Ab, 2 μl anti-CD117 (c-kit)-APC Ab and 2 μl anti-Sca-1 (Ly-6A/E)-biotin Ab.
Mix and incubate on ice for 30 minutes in the dark.
Wash cells twice with 3 ml of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Resuspend cells in 100 μl of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Add 2 μl APC-Cy7 conjugated Streptavidin.
Mix and incubate on ice for 30 minutes in the dark.
Wash cells twice with 3 ml of 1×PBS/2%FCS and resuspend the cells at a concentration of 5 × 10^7/ml for MoFlo analysis.
Add propidium iodide to stain dead cells (final concentration = 2 μg/ml).
Store on ice with no light until analysis/sorting.
Aliquot spleen cells into 7 tubes (50 μl each) and mark each tube as #1-#7.
Tube #1: No addition.
Tube #2: Add propidium iodide (final concentration = 2 μg/ml).
Tube #3: Add 1 μl of anti-B220-FITC.
Tube #4: Add 1 μl of anti-B220-PE.
Tube #5: Add 1 μl of anti-B220-APC.
Tube #6: Add 1 μl of anti-B220-APC-Cy7.
Mix 1 μl of anti-B220-TC in tube #7.
Incubate on ice for 30 minutes in dark.
Wash cells twice with 3 ml of 1×PBS/2%FCS.
Resuspend cells in 500 μl of 1×PBS/2%FCS (do not add PI except for tube #2).
Purify RNA using a RNeasy Micro Kit (Qiagen).

Isolate HSC or myeloid progenitor cells (CMP, GMP, or MEP) using a DakoCytomation High Speed MoFlo Sorter and resort directly into a microfuge tube containing 350 μl of RLT buffer with β-ME and carrier RNA.
Lysate the cells by vortexing for 1 minute if the cell number is lower than 1 × 10^5.
Purify RNA according to the manufacturer's protocol (Qiagen).
Add a DNaseI incubation mix (10 μl DNase I stock solution plus 70 μl Buffer RDD provided by Qiagen) onto a column.
Incubate for 15 minutes between the first and second treatments with RW1 buffer.
